gloss: to contradict; to be inconsistent; to be contradictory

definitions.gloss: to contradict; to be inconsistent; to be contradictory
definitions.explanation: To be logically incompatible or inconsistent with something else. Used when two statements, facts, or actions cannot both be true or coexist.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{話|はなし}は{矛盾|むじゅん}している。
{言|い}っていることと{行動|こうどう}が{矛盾|むじゅん}している。
examples.english: What they say and what they do are contradictory.

examples.japanese: この{二|ふた}つの{報告書|ほうこくしょ}の{内容|ないよう}は{互|たが}いに{矛盾|むじゅん}しているので、{調査|ちょうさ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: The contents of these two reports contradict each other, so an investigation is needed.

notes:
The word {矛盾|むじゅん} comes from a famous Chinese fable about a merchant who claimed his spear ({矛|ほこ}) could pierce anything and his shield ({盾|たて}) could block anything — a logical impossibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {矛盾|むじゅん}を{感|かん}じる — to feel a contradiction
- {矛盾|むじゅん}を{指摘|してき}する — to point out a contradiction
- {矛盾|むじゅん}が{生|しょう}じる — a contradiction arises
- {矛盾|むじゅん}を{抱|かか}える — to harbor a contradiction
- {矛盾|むじゅん}だらけ — full of contradictions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {食|く}い{違|ちが}う — to conflict, to disagree (less formal, more about discrepancies in facts)
- {反|はん}する — to go against, to violate (rules, expectations)
